title: One-shot supernet with architecture-path Mirror correction
hypothesis: A small architecture-path-specific Givens coordinate will reduce one-shot weight-sharing rank bias: validation quality rankings of shared children will correlate better with independently trained child test rankings than plain shared weights and a byte-matched path scalar.
physical_object: one shared three-node DAG supernet with a learned residual transform at each node
mirror_coordinate: one learned Givens angle per architecture path, applied after selected DAG nodes and before the shared readout
logical_multiplicity: eight child models encoded by three binary path decisions

model.paths: all eight binary masks over the three nodes; bit=1 activates that node's residual MLP
model.path_sampling: one path per update, uniformly sampled with the same minibatch/path sequence for all shared variants

controls: eight independently trained child models, one per DAG path; all weights charged
one-shot shared DAG supernet with no path correction
shared supernet plus one direct scalar hidden gain per path (8 learned values)
shared supernet plus one Givens angle per path (8 learned values)
development_gate_before_fresh: Both development seeds: independent path quality has nontrivial spread (test NLL range >=0.02 nat); Mirror improves validation-to-independent-test Spearman rank correlation by >=0.20 versus both plain shared and scalar path code; Mirror mean validation NLL is within 0.03 nat of independent path mean; Mirror payload <=1.10x scalar payload and <=0.50x independent bank; all eight child test scores are reported. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh seeds reproduce rank-correlation gain >=0.20 over both controls, Mirror mean test NLL within 0.03 nat of independent, payload <=0.50x independent, and exact reload/replay.
failure_gate: Mirror rank correlation does not improve by >=0.20 over plain and scalar in both development seeds, or misses quality/byte gates.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: all shared DAG and output weights
all eight path scalars or Mirror angles

compute.rank_metric: Spearman correlation between each shared method's validation child NLL ranking and independent children test NLL ranking

boundaries: synthetic DAG classification screening only; no NAS benchmark or deployment claim
ranking agreement is distinct from child quality; report both
eight path combinations are not eight independent capacities
fixed update evidence is not a near-converged capacity claim
fresh IDs remain sealed until the full development gate passes
